message.content: {"output_action": "CREATE", "skill_draft": {"name": "verify_structural_anomalies_visually_when_tools_negative", "description": "When automated classifiers or report generators fail to detect specific structural anomalies (e.g., situs inversus, bronchiectasis) in syndromic diagnoses, prioritize direct visual inspection of the original image for anatomical laterality and parenchymal patterns.", "applicable_conditions": "Tasks involving medical imaging interpretation where the diagnosis relies on specific structural variants or subtle parenchymal patterns that automated tools may miss or misclassify as negative.", "branch": "task_level", "tool_name": null, "task_category": ["medical_imaging_interpretation"], "required_tools": ["chest_xray_classifier", "chest_xray_report_generator"], "risk_level": "high", "core_action": "If automated tools (e.g., classifier, report generator) return negative results for a suspected syndrome defined by structural variants (such as Kartagener's syndrome): (1) Do not accept the negative output as definitive exclusion; (2) Perform direct visual inspection of the original image to verify anatomical laterality (e.g., dextrocardia, gastric bubble position) and specific parenchymal patterns (e.g., basal opacities, reticulation); (3) Confirm the presence of all syndrome components visually before finalizing the diagnosis."}, "patch_target_id": null, "patch_section": null, "patch_content": null}
